description: Metadata extracted from an ADOC-V1.0 electronically signed document container.

person.description: A party (author, recipient, or receiver) as declared in signable metadata.

code.description: Company registration code or personal code (optional for natural persons)

individual.description: true = natural person, false = legal entity

officer.description: A named employee with optional position and unit, used for signers and registrars.

contentRef.description: A reference to a content file within the package, with its declared MIME type.

path.description: Path relative to the ZIP root

date.description: Registration date (xsd:date or xsd:dateTime with timezone)
Received date (xsd:date or xsd:dateTime with timezone)

containerType.description: Always 'ADOC' — used to discriminate this schema from other metadata types

standardVersion.description: Specification version from unsignable metadata (standardVersion element), e.g. 'ADOC-V1.0'

documentCategory.description: Document group from unsignable metadata: GeDOC = government-issued, GGeDOC = received by government, BeDOC = private legal entity, CeDOC = natural person

title.description: Document title from the signable metadata document/title element

authors.description: Parties that prepared the document (authors/author elements in signable metadata)

registrations.description: Outgoing registration records (registrations/registration in signable metadata)

receptions.description: Incoming registration records — recorded when the document was received and logged by the recipient (receptions/reception in signable metadata)

mainDocument.description: The single main content file, identified via the 'content/main' relationship type in relations.xml

annexes.description: Annex files attached to the main document or to other annexes ('content/appendix' relationships), forming a tree up to 3 levels deep

attachments.description: Independent electronic documents attached to the main document ('content/attachment' relationships); each is a separate .adoc or compatible e-document

signatures.description: All electronic signatures found in the package, each merged from the XAdES signature file and its corresponding entry in the signable metadata

files.description: Flat list of all files in the ZIP (includes META-INF and metadata files; excludes the 'mimetype' entry)

filesTree.description: Directory tree of the same files
